page.overview:
What is Bridge to Kaer Trolde?

Bridge to Kaer Trolde is a short but thick stone bridge set on the path leading to heavy vertically-closing gate of Clan an Craite home base, the citadel of Kaer Trolde. Folks of Ard Skellig are believing in legend that the heroic founder of Clan an Craite and god of warrior, Grymmdjarr, carved the bridge with only one hand.
